criteria.text: Dry-run reports the exact packages/web/.next/cache candidate only for an accepted clean child worktree whose branch is already merged into a delivery target.
Actual cleanup removes only the clean merged child worktree, its exact Next cache, and its safe local branch while preserving dirty, unmerged, protected, and primary worktrees and caches.
The cleanup regression is enforced by CI and process verification, and durable handoff and failure-mode guidance require dry-run-first operation.
